figurative_meaning_en: Fitting exactly as required or tailored to the needed measure
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই শাড়িটা কাটাছাঁটা হয়েছে, ঠিক আমার মতো লাগছে।
তার কথা কাটাছাঁটা, কোনো অতিরিক্ত কথা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This sari is cut and trimmed perfectly, it fits me just right.
His speech was cut and trimmed, without any extra words.
note: Refers to the traditional Bengali practice of custom tailoring clothes to fit precisely.
